candidates.name: Peacock-Blue Mock Neck
candidates.decisionReason: The narrow shoulder, compressed chest, long tight torso and bunched sleeves reproduce the skinny-top silhouette explicitly excluded from the rebuild.

candidates.name: Orange Fuzzy Stripe Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The bold orange is useful, but the floating product image provides no body proof and the fuzzy oversized shape risks novelty volume rather than date polish.

candidates.name: Warm-Apricot Knit Henley
candidates.decisionReason: The warm blush-apricot rib knit has tactile Winter interest, a clean button neckline and controlled relaxed ease without a skinny body or exaggerated drop shoulder.

candidates.name: Peacock-Blue Fine Knit
candidates.decisionReason: Original resolution shows a narrow fitted torso and close sleeves; the attractive blue does not justify repeating the tight-top problem.

candidates.name: Camel Cable Quarter-Zip
candidates.decisionReason: The close body, traditional cable layout and camel tone feel conventional and would create a muddy neutral Winter Date look.

candidates.name: Mustard Half-Zip
candidates.decisionReason: The mustard color is welcome, but the plain technical half-zip reads like a fitted outdoor base layer rather than tactile, date-worthy knitwear.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Washed Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The broad washed leg visibly stacks and cuffs around the shoe, producing the baggy puddled denim silhouette the rebuild is removing.

candidates.name: Dark Zip-Detail Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The dark marbled wash, hip zip details and heavy black-and-white sneaker styling look dated and reintroduce a dark-default lower half.
